summary: Implementation matches the spec. netResult = winner shares + returned (only when returned.seat is the user) - sum of ActionRecord.added (blinds included). That matches the engine: awards exclude returned (hand.ts:76), and per-winner amounts handle split and side pots. The unit test checks netResult against the final stack minus the starting stack on six fixtures, including RAISE_TAKES_BLINDS (returned) and SIDE_POT_SHOWDOWN, and mutates returned to show the test fails without it. Sit-and-go uses the same engine records, with $ per A-4. The copy matches qa.md Q-1 (result · cards · position), Q-2 ('Hand #N · Replay code <code>', 12px) and Q-3 ('You broke even'). The reviewHeader(table) move is behaviour-neutral (MINOR, optional). Tests assert the specified values, and the null/closed/entries-null cases exclude the code and summary. Gates pass. No BLOCKER or MAJOR.
